provenance.input_method: Independent raw pixel aperture: target-centered radius2pixel, median of bottom30%reference pixels sky, QUALITY0, bilateral OOT quadratic baseline excluding +/-1.15*0.08d; no fixed transit-template subtraction or pointing decorrelation.
provenance.timing_caveat: Two measured-era epoch initialization; no repeated photon-derived timing prior used in likelihood.

stellar_prior.limb_darkening_source: Broad approximate TESS priors for a ~4035 K star; no atmosphere interpolation.

radius_profile_summary.warning: Conditional sampled penalized likelihood profile; no calibrated coverage, covariance or mass classification. Fixed stellar-density/limb priors and diagonal errors; grazing upper bounds are artificial.

equal_light_binary_alternative.model: Identical equal-light stars, circular physical orbit twice observed photometric period

individual_stellar_prior.limb_darkening_source: Broad approximate TESS priors for a ~4035 K star; no atmosphere interpolation.

extra_assumptions: Each star has the same Teff and individual radius combined-light inferred radius divided by sqrt2.
Each star mass equals nominal catalog mass with broad density prior; this is illustrative, not an isochrone binary solution.
Two identical limb-darkened eclipses per orbit; background star contributes exactly half the light.
No Roche deformation, spots, mutual irradiation or Doppler beaming; local detrending removes slow orbital light terms.
Both eclipses share geometry and are therefore indistinguishable by odd/even or secondary-at-photometric-half tests.

binary_model_verification.method: Independent full native-time BATMAN primary+secondary models at physical2P, equal discs/brightness, summed lost light; no photometric phase folding.

unequal_brightness_binary_alternative.model: Equal radii, unequal surface brightness, alternating eclipses at physical orbit2P

caveats: No mass measurement; same radii and nominal combined-light radius/√2 approximation despite unequal brightness.
J is a TESS surface-brightness/flux ratio, not a companion mass ratio or calibrated temperature.
Conditional diagonal likelihood with same unmodeled baseline/red-noise covariance as primary fits.
Improvement is a targeted diagnostic, not survey significance or validation.

parity_robustness.fixed_shape: Equal-radius binary physical shape, exact exposures; independent amplitude+constant fit per event.
caveats: A targeted diagnostic, not a global significance or independent use of the same photons.
Stellar activity, fixed-shape mismatch and baseline systematics can affect alternation.
Event bootstrap keeps these observed sectors fixed; two sectors cannot characterize long-term systematics.
Same-source physical and prior QLP diagnostics must not be multiplied as independent probabilities.
